dependencies.reason: The images package sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd at sandbox.AgentPath; the tests use attach.Dial and attach.Config, stdioconn.New, AgentInfo (Version, Workdir, OutlineBackend, Git), ProtocolMajor/ProtocolMinor, ErrToolMismatch and the Tools digest check, and the --version line. This spec adds buildver.stamp to 13's sandbox/internal/buildver, adds sandbox/image.go to package sandbox, and extends 13's README, architecture, configuration and CLI docs.
The agent carries the rsync protocol itself, so the base image ships no rsync binary and TS-16-39 asserts its absence; the root-owned agent follows 14's trust model.

The base image's cgo build links psx's cgo variant through go-landlock, which must link with no CGO_LDFLAGS_ALLOW; the harness starts the agent with sandbox.AgentArgs; the image layout matches 15's writable and read-only roots; the Landlock check reads AgentInfo.Landlock (ABI, Note); 15 bumped the protocol to 1.2, which the --version assertions format from the constants.

The test-only package sandbox/images must pass internal/policy's TestCrossTargetBuildAndVet and TestHostCgoBuildAndVet, TS-09-15/TS-09-16 must stay green with no new require, and TS-09-20 (make check) must stay green and offline.
TS-12-14's line budget in core/size_test.go counts the production lines sandbox/image.go and the buildver change add; TS-16-29 runs it.

tasks.title: Add the image references, ImageTag, DefaultImage, OverlayImage and OverlayCopyLine to package sandbox
steps: Write TS-16-4, TS-16-5 and TS-16-9 as table tests in sandbox/image_test.go (package sandbox_test) with exactly the accepted and refused rows the test spec lists, requiring ("", false) for every refusal

tasks.title: Build the image-test harness: engine selection, skip gates, run command, attach, cleanup and shared checks
steps: Write TS-16-22, TS-16-23, TS-16-24 and TS-16-25 in sandbox/images/harness_test.go against injected getenv/lookPath, a recording command runner and a recording logger, and TS-16-47 and TS-16-48 as opt-in tests gated like the image tests; confirm they fail

Implement start(ctx, engine, image) (*harness, error): exec.Cmd from runArgs with StdinPipe/StdoutPipe and stderr into a mutex-guarded buffer; conn := stdioconn.New(stdout, stdin); attach.Dial(ctx, conn, attach.Config{ID: name, Spec: spec, Destroy: kill the child, wait for it and run `engine rm -f name`, Provider: "imgtest"}); on any failure wait briefly for the child to exit, run cleanup and return an error that carries the image, the cause and the engine's stderr

Implement execIn(ctx, tools []core.Tool, command string) (rc int, out string, err error): call the proxy execute tool's Execute or Handler with {"command": command + "; echo rc=$?"}, take the rendered text (ToolResult.LLMText or the handler JSON), parse and strip the trailing rc= line; and callTool for write_file
